import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    home = lines[0].split("=")[1].strip()
    for raw in lines[1:]:
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
        fields = raw.split(";")
        title = fields[0].strip() if len(fields) >= 1 else ""
        first = fields[1].strip() if len(fields) >= 2 else ""
        last = fields[2].strip() if len(fields) >= 3 else ""
        street = fields[3].strip() if len(fields) >= 4 else ""
        postcode = fields[4].strip() if len(fields) >= 5 else ""
        city = fields[5].strip() if len(fields) >= 6 else ""
        country = fields[6].strip() if len(fields) >= 7 else ""

        name_line = " ".join(filter(lambda x: x, [title, first, last]))
        name_line = "To the occupant" if first == "" and last == "" else name_line

        if street == "" and postcode == "" and city == "":
            continue

        print(name_line)
        if street:
            print(street)
        if postcode or city:
            print(f"{postcode} {city}")
        if country and country.strip().upper() != home.upper():
            print(country.upper())
        if street != "" or (postcode != "" or city != ""):
            print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
